name: Crow
style: mid-poly, realistic proportions, cut primary feathers (Teh_Bucket); texture dropped, one flat material

source.author: Teh_Bucket
source.note: Assigned as wave-1 row 32 (small bird: Quaternius Cute Creatures Birb on poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked), and no reachable Quaternius pack has a bird. The reachable free animated birds on OpenGameArt were compared in the lab: a CC0 cardinal (gonzalfj) has one material and one near-static idle with no flight; a CC0 pigeon (mujtaba-io) has a good flap loop but holds its wings spread out in every clip, even its idle; this CC0 raven reads best, perches with folded wings and has a full flight loop. So it fills row 36 (crow / raven, a gap) instead. Its idle is the source's one-frame 'stand' perch (a static hold); its rest pose has the wings spread. The texture (an external, missing file) is not used: one material, drawn as black plumage over a navy sheen.
